name: OPA1692 (TI SoundPlus low-power, low-noise dual bipolar-input audio op-amp)
tagline: Draws only 650 µA per channel yet gives 4.2 nV/√Hz and -127 dB distortion. Low-power audio builders and Head-Fi op-amp rollers rate it highly.
technology: Bipolar-input, low-power SoundPlus dual audio op-amp (TI, 2017). Rail-to-rail output swings to within 200 mV of the supplies into 2 kΩ. 4.2 nV/√Hz at 1 kHz, -127 dB distortion at 1 kHz, 650 µA per channel. Web search summaries give 5.1 MHz GBW and 23 V/µs slew. The earlier sweep gave a 3.5 V to 36 V supply and ±50 mA output; this pass did not confirm those two.

reputation.summary: Cycfi Research's 2017 blog post 'OPA1692: The perfect Op Amp for low power audio?' says it 'sounds fast, dynamic and had good timing on most CDs', though the LME49723 separated instruments better on one track. In Head-Fi's 'The Opamp thread', posters rank it among the three best on specs (with the OPA2209 and OPA2189) and prefer it to the OPA1678. The praise comes from a few listener reports, not from measurements.
typical_uses: op-amp rolling in DIP-8 sockets using SOIC-to-DIP adapters
caveats: SMD only (SOIC-8, VSSOP-8), so DIP sockets need an adapter
Cycfi preferred the LME49723 for instrument separation on one track
Praise rests on a small number of subjective reports

revision_history.changes: First release. Covered the OPA1692 dual and the OPA1694 quad (SOIC-14/TSSOP-14). Advance Information status, as implied by rev A's change note.
Changed from Advance Information to Production Data. Per a TI E2E thread, removed all references to the OPA1694.
Exists: it is the 'before' version in the Nov 2018 change notice. Contents not retrieved.

Specification changes 'to accurately reflect device characteristics'. The device did not change, and TI expected no impact on fit, form, function, quality or reliability. Announced in a TI notification dated 5 Nov 2018. Exact parameter changes not retrieved. Latest revision found.

Date confirmed by a copy of the datasheet itself, not only by E2E. The radiolocman mirror (di=486003) is summarised as 'SBOS566A, June 2017, revised December 2017'. Changes as already recorded: Advance Information to Production Data, and OPA1694 references removed. No new change details were retrieved.

Supporting evidence: the ic114 copy (already listed) is titled 'OPA1692, OPA1694', and the search summary shows 'SBOS566 – JUNE 2017' covering both the OPA1692 and the OPA1694. Since rev A removed the OPA1694, the ic114 PDF is very likely the original June 2017 Advance Information edition. The device was publicly discussed at launch in August 2017 (Cycfi Research blog, https://www.cycfi.com/2017/08/opa1692-the-perfect-opamp-for-low-power-audio/).

silicon_changes.identification: None needed. The silicon did not change, so parts built before and after Nov 2018 are the same device. Only the datasheet limits and typicals differ between SBOS566B and SBOS566C.
silicon_changes.summary: No silicon change is known. The only TI notice found is a datasheet-only specification change (SBOS566B to SBOS566C) to 'accurately reflect device characteristics', with no change to the device. Which parameters changed was not retrieved, so specs quoted from rev B or earlier copies may differ from rev C.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: None expected, since the die is the same. When comparing specs, use rev C values.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low - datasheet-only change; the notice says there is no device change

counterfeit_notes: No specific counterfeit reports found. The top-side marking is 'OP1692' (TI package marking, mirrored on alldatasheet.net). The part is SMD only (SOIC-8, VSSOP-8). Marketplace sellers (e.g. eBay) sell 'OPA1692IDR' pre-soldered on DIP-8 adapters for op-amp rolling. Buy from TI or authorized distributors (Mouser, Digi-Key, Farnell) and check the OP1692 marking and TI logo/date code.
alternatives: OPA1662 (TI OPA166x low-power bipolar SoundPlus, higher current)

revision_chain_notes:
Texas Instruments SBOS566 (sole vendor; no second sources, acquirer re-issues or other vendors' editions exist). The chain from oldest to newest:
(1) SBOS566 original, June 2017. Advance Information; covered the OPA1692 and the OPA1694. Held by the already-listed ic114 copy (http://product.ic114.com/PDF/O/OPA1692.PDF), whose title 'OPA1692, OPA1694' and summary 'SBOS566 – JUNE 2017' support upgrading that entry to 'original, June 2017' at medium confidence. The already-listed alldatasheet 954302 (23 pages, 'Audio Operational Amplifiers' title) is probably the same edition, but the revision is not shown.
(2) SBOS566A, revised December 2017. Production Data; OPA1694 removed. The date is now confirmed by a datasheet copy, the NEW radiolocman mirror di=486003 (medium).
(3) SBOS566B. Revision date still MISSING (between Dec 2017 and Oct 2018). No copy positively identified as rev B; the 42-page alldatasheet(.net) copies 1096308/1096309/1096312 could be B or C (revision not shown).
(4) SBOS566C, revised October 2018. Specification changes 'to accurately reflect device characteristics' (TI notification of 5 Nov 2018, Farnell 2721178). Held by ti.com/lit/gpn/OPA1692 and Scribd sbos566c.
Still missing: the SBOS566B date and change list, the exact parameter changes from B to C, and any later revision (D or beyond) after 2018; the searches found none. Seeds for the Wayback Machine: ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/opa1692.pdf, with captures from 2017 to 2018 expected to hold the original, A and B.
